children: Overview
UK mobile payments provider's FY26 gross profit grew 12.9%, with adjusted EBITDA up 11%
Adjusted EPS for FY26 rose 7.1% year-on-year
Company returned £2.4 mln via share buybacks and raised final dividend
Outlook
Fonix expects Portugal, Switzerland and France to contribute to growth in FY27
Company targets significant increase in PayFlex transaction volumes through expanded rollout
Fonix plans to launch in a sixth European market towards end of FY27
Result Drivers

MOBILE PAYMENTS & MESSAGING - Growth in gross profit was driven by continued strength in the media sector and increased contributions from Portugal and Switzerland, with mobile payments up 11% and mobile messaging up 28%
PRODUCT INNOVATION - Launch and adoption of PayFlex and CompsPortal, along with RichMessaging trials, contributed to growth
REVENUE MIX SHIFT - Blended gross profit margin decreased slightly due to growth in lower-margin mobile messaging and a decline in managed services gross profit
